notes.title: Update Notes for 5/19/2021
notes.notes:
Offline Practice:
- New offline practice mode has been added so the game can be played in singleplayer

Balance:
- Timed wall laser cost and damage changes
- Number of drones reduced in the later sections of Helios
- Respawning players no longer costs health
- Melee drones now turn faster to better follow runners
- Ability activation disabled in waiting rooms to prevent accidental use

Weapons:
- Juggernaut projectile can now pass through drone shields with reduced damage
- Increased weapon accuracy at long range

Fixes:
- Fixed exploit where shield drone shields could be recharged early by possessing
- Fixed shield drones not automatically rebuilding their shields
- Fixed invulnerability time while dashing
- Fixed one way shields trapping runners in spawn
- Stability improvements

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/8/2021
notes.notes:
Weapons:
- Minor shotgun buffs and damage increase
- Railgun reworked to be easier to use
- Railgun damage increased

Runners:
- Invulnerability time while dashing increased
- Color change option is now available in the runner shop (costs 0 credits)

Fixes:
- Fixed weapons jamming when swapping and firing at the same time

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/4/2021
notes.notes:
Runners:
- Added muzzle flash effects to railgun and shotgun
- Fixed other runners stuttering when dashing

Sentinel:
- Increased sentinel placement time and credits by 25% on Aegis
- Locked rotation of shield drone's large shield while turning

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed drone spawning doors sometimes not opening

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/1/2021
notes.notes:
Balancing:
- All drones have been made faster by about 30%
- Posessed melee drones have been made about 40% faster
- Drones should now spread out a little bit more
- Shield power up invulnerability after getting hit increased from 2 to 3 seconds
- Locked laser drone rotation while firing when possessed to prevent an exploit
- Increased starting runner upgrade credits to 2

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed lasers appearing to go through walls for runners
- Fixed shield drone slow field slowing the player for the rest of the match

Polish:
- Replaced health counter on destructible walls with a health bar
- Revised credits screen

HUD:
- Reorganized sentinel hotbar for faster drone selection

notes.title: Update Notes for 4/27/2021 Pt. 2
notes.notes:
Runners:
- Juggernaut weapon model updated
- Fixed multiple movement speed exploits
- Gatling gun model updated

Sentinel:
- Fixed crashing when unpossessing shield drone
- Improved placement detection stability

UI:
- Rearranged sentinel UI for better readability
- Adjusted runner UI colors for better readability
- Runner UI now shows a secondary weapon

notes.title: Update Notes for 4/27/2021
notes.notes:
Sentinel:
- Sentinel can no longer place inside walls on Aegis
- Removed "big boi": will no longer spawn when removing a recently placed drone

Runners:
- Fixed players respawning too close to upgrade kiosks
- Can no longer dash through slow field
- Fixed slow field freezing player

Drones/Traps:
- Pre-placed AI now working as intended
- Improved AI responsiveness
- Made bear trap less visible
- Tripwires can no longer be placed in contact with doors
- Fixed laser drone and laser trap double-damage bug
- Killed drones when they fall off the map
- Aegis boss minion spawn timer scales with number of players
- Fixed timed lasers not handling doors properly
- Extended laser drone lasers and made them less accurate
- Add materialization effect to miniboss drones and challenge door drones

Weapons:
- Fixed Juggernaut shots colliding with slow field
- Fixed AI not attacking players after being shot with certain weapons
- Fixed some weapons not damaging breakable walls
- Increased railgun sound volume
- Added juggernaut charge sound
- Slight decrease to railgun ramp-up time

Menus:
- Fixed video settings crashing the game
- Added credits screen
- Updated main menu
- Fixed sentinel not being able to interact with end-game UIs
- Greyed out runner upgrades that cannot be purchased
- Adjusted anchor points in general player UI for better scaling
- Fixed waiting lobby player list not updating properly after player disconnects
- Fixed matchmaking issues after leaving a match

Sound:
- Added sound to wall destruction
- Added spawn sound to challenge doors and miniboss spawner

Miscellaneous:
- Added one-way shield to Aegis spawn area
